```{python}

id_columns = ['Source Name', 'Group']
clustering_columns = [c for c in full_df.columns if c not in id_columns]

# Compute nullity matrix and correlation
null_matrix = full_df[clustering_columns].isnull().astype(int)
null_corr = null_matrix.corr()

# Distance matrix (distance = 1 - abs(correlation))
distance_matrix = 1 - null_corr.abs()
_dm = distance_matrix.to_numpy(copy=True)
np.fill_diagonal(_dm, 0)
distance_matrix = pd.DataFrame(_dm, index=distance_matrix.index, columns=distance_matrix.columns)
distance_matrix = distance_matrix.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 1).fillna(1)

condensed_distance = squareform(distance_matrix.values, checks=False)
linkage_matrix = linkage(condensed_distance, method='average')
column_order_indices = leaves_list(linkage_matrix)
ordered_clustering_columns = [clustering_columns[i] for i in column_order_indices]

import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 7), dpi=600)
dendrogram(
    linkage_matrix,
    labels=clustering_columns,
    orientation='top',
    leaf_rotation=90,
    leaf_font_size=6,
    truncate_mode='lastp',
    p=30,
    show_contracted=True,
    above_threshold_color='#444444',
    color_threshold=0.4 * max(linkage_matrix[:, 2]),
    ax=ax
)
ax.set_title('Hierarchical Clustering of Features by Missingness Pattern',
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', pad=14)
ax.set_xlabel('Features', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', labelpad=10)
ax.set_ylabel('Distance', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', labelpad=10)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=12)
ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=12)
for label in ax.get_xticklabels() + ax.get_yticklabels():
    label.set_fontweight('bold')
ymin, ymax = ax.get_ylim()
ax.set_ylim(bottom=-0.02 * ymax)
ax.tick_params(axis='x', pad=4)

ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['bottom'].set_linewidth(1.2)
ax.spines['left'].set_linewidth(1.2)

for line in ax.get_lines():
    line.set_linewidth(1.8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("nullity_dendrogram_features.png", dpi=600, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

# 6. Final ordered columns: id columns + clustered columns
final_order = id_columns + ordered_clustering_columns
ordered_df = full_df[final_order]


print("Final optimal column order:", final_order[:10])
# ordered_df is ready for imputation, with 'Group' available for grouping!
```

## Instead of showing full correlation matrices, show only top N correlations
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| label: Correlation Function
N = 50  # adjust as needed

from IPython.display import display as _display

def plot_correlation_matrix(df, title, save_path=None):
    corr_matrix = df.corr(numeric_only=True).iloc[:N, :N]
    n = len(corr_matrix)
    fig_w = min(10, max(6, n * 0.55))
    fig_h = min(10, max(6, n * 0.45))

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(fig_w, fig_h), dpi=600)
    sns.heatmap(
        corr_matrix,
        cmap='coolwarm',
        center=0,
        vmin=-1, vmax=1,
        annot=(n <= 20),
        fmt='.2f' if n <= 20 else '',
        annot_kws={"size": 7, "weight": "bold"} if n <= 20 else {},
        linewidths=0.3,
        linecolor='lightgrey',
        ax=ax,
        cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.7, "label": "Pearson Correlation"}
    )
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
    ax.set_xticklabels(ax.get_xticklabels(), fontsize=7, rotation=90, ha='center')
    ax.set_yticklabels(ax.get_yticklabels(), fontsize=7, rotation=0)
    ax.figure.axes[-1].yaxis.label.set_size(12)
    ax.figure.axes[-1].tick_params(labelsize=12)

    plt.tight_layout()

    # Auto-generate save path from title if not provided
    if save_path is None:
        safe_name = title.lower().replace(' ', '_').replace('(', '').replace(')', '').replace('/', '_')
        save_path = f"{safe_name}.png"
    fig.savefig(save_path, dpi=600, bbox_inches='tight')

    _display(fig)
    plt.close(fig)
```

### Full Data
```{python}
#| label: KNN Grid Search Full Data
#| echo: false

if os.path.exists('full_df_knn2.csv'):
    full_df_knn2 = pd.read_csv('full_df_knn2.csv')
else:
    # Ordinal-encode Group: F=0, GC=1, CC1=2, CC2=3, Viv=4
    group_ordinal_map = {'F': 0, 'GC': 1, 'CC1': 2, 'CC2': 3, 'Viv': 4}
    group_ordinal = ordered_df['Group'].map(group_ordinal_map).values.reshape(-1, 1)
    unmapped = ordered_df['Group'][pd.isna(ordered_df['Group'].map(group_ordinal_map))].unique()
    if len(unmapped):
        raise ValueError(f"Unmapped Group values: {unmapped}")

    feature_cols = [c for c in ordered_df.columns if c not in ['Source Name', 'Group']]
    X = np.hstack([ordered_df[feature_cols].values.astype(float), group_ordinal])
    col_names = feature_cols + ['Group_ordinal']

    # ── Grid search via masked-value recovery ──────────────────────────────────
    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
    known_mask = ~np.isnan(X)
    test_mask  = known_mask & (rng.random(X.shape) < 0.05)   # hold out ~10 % of known values

    X_masked = X.copy()
    original_values = X[test_mask]
    X_masked[test_mask] = np.nan

    # Scale using nanmean/nanstd so NaNs are handled correctly
    col_means_gs = np.nanmean(X_masked, axis=0)
    col_stds_gs  = np.nanstd(X_masked,  axis=0)
    col_stds_gs[col_stds_gs == 0] = 1
    X_scaled_gs = (X_masked - col_means_gs) / col_stds_gs

    param_grid = list(itertools.product([2, 3, 5, 7, 10], ['uniform', 'distance']))
    gs_results = []

    for n_neighbors, weights in param_grid:
        imp = KNNImputer(n_neighbors=n_neighbors, weights=weights)
        X_imp     = imp.fit_transform(X_scaled_gs)
        X_imp_inv = X_imp * col_stds_gs + col_means_gs
        rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((X_imp_inv[test_mask] - original_values) ** 2))
        gs_results.append({'n_neighbors': n_neighbors, 'weights': weights, 'rmse': rmse})

    gs_df = pd.DataFrame(gs_results).sort_values('rmse').reset_index(drop=True)
    print("Grid search results (sorted by RMSE):")
    display(gs_df)

    # Plot grid search results
    fig_gs, ax_gs = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4), dpi=600)
    for w in ['uniform', 'distance']:
        sub = gs_df[gs_df['weights'] == w].sort_values('n_neighbors')
        ax_gs.plot(sub['n_neighbors'], sub['rmse'], marker='o', label=w)
    ax_gs.set_xlabel('n_neighbors', fontsize=12)
    ax_gs.set_ylabel('RMSE (masked recovery)', fontsize=12)
    ax_gs.set_title('KNN Grid Search – Full Data', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
    ax_gs.legend(title='weights')
    ax_gs.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax_gs.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig('knn_grid_search_full_df.png', dpi=600, bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.show()

    best_row    = gs_df.iloc[0]
    best_params = {'n_neighbors': int(best_row['n_neighbors']), 'weights': best_row['weights']}
    print(f"\nBest params: {best_params}  →  RMSE = {best_row['rmse']:.4f}")

    # ── Final imputation with best params ─────────────────────────────────────
    col_means_f = np.nanmean(X, axis=0)
    col_stds_f  = np.nanstd(X,  axis=0)
    col_stds_f[col_stds_f == 0] = 1
    X_scaled_f = (X - col_means_f) / col_stds_f

    imp_best = KNNImputer(**best_params)
    X_imp_f     = imp_best.fit_transform(X_scaled_f)
    X_imp_inv_f = X_imp_f * col_stds_f + col_means_f

    full_df_knn2 = pd.DataFrame(X_imp_inv_f, columns=col_names)
    full_df_knn2['Source Name'] = ordered_df['Source Name'].values
    full_df_knn2['Group']       = ordered_df['Group'].values
    full_df_knn2.to_csv('full_df_knn2.csv', index=False)
    joblib.dump(
        {'params': best_params, 'col_means': col_means_f,
         'col_stds': col_stds_f, 'col_names': col_names},
        'knn2_impute_full_df_pipeline.joblib'
    )

plot_correlation_matrix(full_df_knn2, "KNN Correlation Matrix (Top 50x50)", save_path="full_df_knn2.png")
```

## Multiple Imputation by Chained Equation

One can impute missing values by predicting them using other features from the dataset.

The MICE or ‘Multiple Imputations by Chained Equations’, aka, ‘Fully Conditional Specification’ is a popular approach to do this.

Here is a quick intuition (not the exact algorithm)
![Image](mice.png)

- You basically take the variable that contains missing values as a response ‘Y’ and other variables as predictors ‘X’.

- Build a model with rows where Y is not missing.

- Then predict the missing observations.

Do this multiple times by doing random draws of the data and taking the mean of the predictions.


### MICE with Bagging Regressor
**Flight Data**
```{python}
#| label: MICE Bagging Regressor Flight Data
#| echo: false
#| cache: true

if os.path.exists('flight_imputed_mice_bagger.csv'):
  df_bag_imputed_flight_br = pd.read_csv('flight_imputed_mice_bagger.csv')

else:
  ss = StandardScaler()
  bagger = BaggingRegressor(random_state=2, n_jobs=-1, warm_start=True)
  itera_bagger = IterativeImputer(random_state=2, initial_strategy='median', estimator=bagger, max_iter=10, tol=0.01,imputation_order='roman', skip_complete=True)
  itera_impute_pipe = Pipeline([('scaler', ss), ('itera_impute_bagger', itera_bagger)])

  itera_impute_pipe.fit(merged_flight_data.drop(columns=['Source Name', 'Group']))
  df_bag_imputed_flight_br = itera_impute_pipe.transform(merged_flight_data.drop(columns=['Source Name', 'Group']))
  df_bag_imputed_flight_br = itera_impute_pipe.named_steps['scaler'].inverse_transform(df_bag_imputed_flight_br)

  df_bag_imputed_flight_br = pd.DataFrame(df_bag_imputed_flight_br, columns=merged_flight_data.drop(columns=['Source Name', 'Group']).columns.to_list())
  df_bag_imputed_flight_br['Source Name'] = merged_flight_data['Source Name']
  df_bag_imputed_flight_br['Group'] = merged_flight_data['Group']

  df_bag_imputed_flight_br.to_csv('flight_imputed_mice_bagger.csv', index=False)
  joblib.dump(itera_impute_pipe, 'itera_impute_flight_pipeline.joblib')

plot_correlation_matrix(df_bag_imputed_flight_br, "MICE Baggigng Regressor Correlation Matrix (Top 50x50)")
```

**Full Data**

```{python}
#| label: MICE Bagging Regressor Full Data
#| echo: false

import time

def _log(msg, t0=None):
    ts = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
    elapsed = f"  (+{time.time()-t0:.1f}s)" if t0 is not None else ""
    print(f"[{ts}]{elapsed}  {msg}")

if os.path.exists('full_df_mice_bayesridge.csv'):
    _log("Cache hit — loading full_df_mice_bayesridge.csv")
    df_imputed = pd.read_csv('full_df_mice_bayesridge.csv')
    _log(f"Loaded: {df_imputed.shape[0]} rows × {df_imputed.shape[1]} cols")
else:
    t_total = time.time()

    # ── 1. Ordinal-encode Group: F=0, GC=1, CC1=2, CC2=3, Viv=4 ──────────────
    _log("Step 1/5  Ordinal-encoding Group column (F=0, GC=1, CC1=2, CC2=3, Viv=4)")
    group_ordinal_map = {'F': 0, 'GC': 1, 'CC1': 2, 'CC2': 3, 'Viv': 4}
    group_ordinal = ordered_df['Group'].map(group_ordinal_map).values.reshape(-1, 1)
    unmapped = ordered_df['Group'][pd.isna(ordered_df['Group'].map(group_ordinal_map))].unique()
    if len(unmapped):
        raise ValueError(f"Unmapped Group values: {unmapped}")
    for label, code in sorted(group_ordinal_map.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]):
        n = int((ordered_df['Group'] == label).sum())
        _log(f"          {label}={code}  →  {n} samples")

    feature_cols = [c for c in ordered_df.columns if c not in ['Source Name', 'Group']]
    X = np.hstack([ordered_df[feature_cols].values.astype(float), group_ordinal])
    col_names = feature_cols + ['Group_ordinal']
    n_rows, n_cols = X.shape
    n_missing = int(np.isnan(X).sum())
    _log(f"          Matrix: {n_rows} rows × {n_cols} cols  |  missing values: {n_missing} ({100*n_missing/(n_rows*n_cols):.1f}%)")

    # ── 2. Prepare masked hold-out set ────────────────────────────────────────
    _log("Step 2/5  Creating masked hold-out set (10% of known values)")
    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
    known_mask = ~np.isnan(X)
    test_mask  = known_mask & (rng.random(X.shape) < 0.10)
    _log(f"          Hold-out size: {int(test_mask.sum())} values")

    X_masked = X.copy()
    original_values = X[test_mask]
    X_masked[test_mask] = np.nan

    col_means_gs = np.nanmean(X_masked, axis=0)
    col_stds_gs  = np.nanstd(X_masked,  axis=0)
    col_stds_gs[col_stds_gs == 0] = 1
    X_scaled_gs = (X_masked - col_means_gs) / col_stds_gs

    # ── 3. Grid search ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Findings from prior 20-fit run:
    #   • n_nearest=5 was the clear winner — lock it in
    #   • max_iter=5 beat max_iter=3 significantly — push higher
    #   • heavy-tailed biological data → test robust estimators alongside Ridge
    from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge, HuberRegressor, ElasticNet, ARDRegression


    ESTIMATORS = {
        # 'ridge':      Ridge(),
        'elasticnet': ElasticNet(alpha=0.1, l1_ratio=0.5, max_iter=500),
        'ard':        ARDRegression(),
        'huber':      HuberRegressor(epsilon=1.35, max_iter=300),
        
    }

    # 4 estimators × 5 n_nearest × 3 max_iter = 60 fits
    # initial_strategy fixed to 'mean' — washes out with enough iterations
    # max_iter starts at 5 (3 showed ConvergenceWarning on all combos)
    param_grid = list(itertools.product(
        ESTIMATORS.keys(),    # estimator
        [2, 3, 5, 7, 10],    # n_nearest_features
        [3, 5, 7, 10],           # max_iter
    ))
    FIXED_STRATEGY = 'mean'
    _log(f"Step 3/5  Grid search — {len(param_grid)} combinations "
         f"(3 estimators × 5 n_nearest × 3 max_iter  |  strategy='{FIXED_STRATEGY}' fixed)")
    gs_results = []

    for i, (est_name, n_nearest, max_iter) in enumerate(param_grid, 1):
        t_combo = time.time()
        _log(f"          [{i}/{len(param_grid)}] "
             f"estimator={est_name!r}, n_nearest={n_nearest}, max_iter={max_iter} — fitting …")
        itera = IterativeImputer(
            random_state=2, initial_strategy=FIXED_STRATEGY,
            estimator=ESTIMATORS[est_name],
            n_nearest_features=n_nearest,
            max_iter=max_iter, tol=0.01, imputation_order='roman', skip_complete=True
        )
        X_imp     = itera.fit_transform(X_scaled_gs)
        X_imp_inv = X_imp * col_stds_gs + col_means_gs
        rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((X_imp_inv[test_mask] - original_values) ** 2))
        gs_results.append({'estimator': est_name, 'n_nearest': n_nearest,
                           'max_iter': max_iter, 'rmse': rmse})
        _log(f"          [{i}/{len(param_grid)}] done — RMSE={rmse:.4f}", t_combo)

    gs_df = pd.DataFrame(gs_results).sort_values('rmse').reset_index(drop=True)
    _log("Step 3/5  Grid search complete — results (sorted by RMSE):")
    display(gs_df)

    # Plot: one subplot per estimator, x=n_nearest, lines=max_iter
    est_names   = list(ESTIMATORS.keys())
    max_iters   = [5, 7, 10]
    line_colors = {5: '#4C72B0', 7: '#DD8452', 10: '#55A868'}

    fig_gs, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(est_names), figsize=(14, 4), dpi=150, sharey=True)
    for ax, est_name in zip(axes, est_names):
        sub_e = gs_df[gs_df['estimator'] == est_name]
        for mi, color in line_colors.items():
            s = sub_e[sub_e['max_iter'] == mi].sort_values('n_nearest')
            ax.plot(s['n_nearest'], s['rmse'], marker='o', color=color, label=f"iter={mi}")
        ax.set_title(est_name, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
        ax.set_xlabel('n_nearest_features', fontsize=10)
        ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
        ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    axes[0].set_ylabel('RMSE (masked recovery)', fontsize=10)
    axes[-1].legend(title='max_iter', fontsize=8, bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left')
    fig_gs.suptitle(f"MICE Grid Search – Full Data  (strategy='{FIXED_STRATEGY}')",
                    fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig('mice_grid_search_full_df.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.show()

    best_row       = gs_df.iloc[0]
    best_est_name  = best_row['estimator']
    best_n_nearest = int(best_row['n_nearest'])
    best_params    = {'initial_strategy': FIXED_STRATEGY,
                      'max_iter':         int(best_row['max_iter'])}
    _log(f"          Best: estimator={best_est_name!r}, n_nearest={best_n_nearest}, "
         f"max_iter={best_params['max_iter']}  →  RMSE={best_row['rmse']:.4f}")

    # ── 4 & 5 moved to "Parameter Search on Best Estimator" cell ─────────────
    # Final imputation runs there using the Stage-2 tuned estimator.

plot_correlation_matrix(df_imputed, "MICE  Correlation Matrix (Top 50x50)", save_path="full_df_mice_ridge.png")

```

## Parameter Search on Best Estimator

```{python}
#| label: Parameter Search on Best Estimator (ARD)
#| echo: false

"""
ARD Hyperparameter Tuning for MICE Imputation
==============================================
Focused grid search on ARD and ElasticNet estimators
based on findings from initial broad grid search.

Key finding from initial search:
- ARD with n_nearest=7, max_iter=5 → RMSE=53.41 (best so far)
- ElasticNet with n_nearest=7, max_iter=10 → RMSE=57.50
- Huber fails to converge on this dataset — excluded
- RMSE is non-monotonic with max_iter — overfitting occurs at high iterations
"""

import os
import time
import itertools
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import joblib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.experimental import enable_iterative_imputer  # noqa
from sklearn.impute import IterativeImputer
from sklearn.linear_model import ARDRegression, ElasticNet

# ── Logging helper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def _log(msg, t0=None):
    ts = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
    elapsed = f"  (+{time.time()-t0:.1f}s)" if t0 is not None else ""
    print(f"[{ts}]{elapsed}  {msg}")

# ── Load ordered dataset ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Replace with your actual ordered_df loading code
# ordered_df = pd.read_csv('ordered_df.csv')

# ── Step 1: Ordinal-encode Group ──────────────────────────────────────────────
_log("Step 1/5  Ordinal-encoding Group column (F=0, GC=1, CC1=2, CC2=3, Viv=4)")
group_ordinal_map = {'F': 0, 'GC': 1, 'CC1': 2, 'CC2': 3, 'Viv': 4}
group_ordinal = ordered_df['Group'].map(group_ordinal_map).values.reshape(-1, 1)

feature_cols = [c for c in ordered_df.columns if c not in ['Source Name', 'Group']]
X = np.hstack([ordered_df[feature_cols].values.astype(float), group_ordinal])
col_names = feature_cols + ['Group_ordinal']
n_rows, n_cols = X.shape
n_missing = int(np.isnan(X).sum())
_log(f"          Matrix: {n_rows} rows × {n_cols} cols  |  "
     f"missing: {n_missing} ({100*n_missing/(n_rows*n_cols):.1f}%)")

# ── Step 2: Masked hold-out set ───────────────────────────────────────────────
_log("Step 2/5  Creating masked hold-out set (10% of known values)")
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
known_mask = ~np.isnan(X)
test_mask  = known_mask & (rng.random(X.shape) < 0.10)
_log(f"          Hold-out size: {int(test_mask.sum())} values")

X_masked = X.copy()
original_values = X[test_mask]
X_masked[test_mask] = np.nan

col_means_gs = np.nanmean(X_masked, axis=0)
col_stds_gs  = np.nanstd(X_masked,  axis=0)
col_stds_gs[col_stds_gs == 0] = 1
X_scaled_gs = (X_masked - col_means_gs) / col_stds_gs

# ── Step 3: Focused grid search ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Based on initial search findings:
# - n_nearest=5 and n_nearest=7 are the sweet spot
# - max_iter=3-10 is the relevant range
# - Adding max_iter=15 to test if improvement continues beyond 10
# - ARD hyperparameters: alpha_1, alpha_2 control sparsity
# - ElasticNet hyperparameters: alpha, l1_ratio control regularization

ESTIMATORS = {
    # ARD variants — testing different sparsity levels
    'ard_default':    ARDRegression(),
    'ard_sparse':     ARDRegression(alpha_1=1m0 -4, alpha_2=1e-4,
                                    lambda_1=1e-4, lambda_2=1e-4),
    'ard_dense':      ARDRegression(alpha_1=1e-6, alpha_2=1e-6,
                                    lambda_1=1e-6, lambda_2=1e-6),
    # ElasticNet variants — testing different regularization strengths
    'elasticnet_default': ElasticNet(alpha=0.1, l1_ratio=0.5, max_iter=500),
    'elasticnet_l1':      ElasticNet(alpha=0.1, l1_ratio=0.9, max_iter=500),
    'elasticnet_l2':      ElasticNet(alpha=0.1, l1_ratio=0.1, max_iter=500),
    'elasticnet_weak':    ElasticNet(alpha=0.01, l1_ratio=0.5, max_iter=500),
    'elasticnet_strong':  ElasticNet(alpha=1.0, l1_ratio=0.5, max_iter=500),
}

N_NEAREST_OPTIONS = [5, 7]
MAX_ITER_OPTIONS  = [3, 5, 10, 15]

param_grid = list(itertools.product(
    ESTIMATORS.keys(),
    N_NEAREST_OPTIONS,
    MAX_ITER_OPTIONS,
))

n_total = len(param_grid)
_log(f"Step 3/5  Focused grid search — {n_total} combinations "
     f"({len(ESTIMATORS)} estimators × "
     f"{len(N_NEAREST_OPTIONS)} n_nearest × "
     f"{len(MAX_ITER_OPTIONS)} max_iter)")

gs_results = []
t_search = time.time()

for i, (est_name, n_nearest, max_iter) in enumerate(param_grid, 1):
    t_combo = time.time()
    _log(f"          [{i}/{n_total}] "
         f"estimator={est_name!r}, n_nearest={n_nearest}, "
         f"max_iter={max_iter} — fitting …")

    itera = IterativeImputer(
        random_state=42,
        initial_strategy='mean',
        estimator=ESTIMATORS[est_name],
        n_nearest_features=n_nearest,
        max_iter=max_iter,
        tol=0.01,
        imputation_order='roman',
        skip_complete=True,
    )
    X_imp     = itera.fit_transform(X_scaled_gs)
    X_imp_inv = X_imp * col_stds_gs + col_means_gs
    rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((X_imp_inv[test_mask] - original_values) ** 2))

    gs_results.append({
        'estimator':  est_name,
        'n_nearest':  n_nearest,
        'max_iter':   max_iter,
        'rmse':       rmse,
    })
    _log(f"          [{i}/{n_total}] done — RMSE={rmse:.4f}", t_combo)

_log(f"Step 3/5  Grid search complete — total elapsed: "
     f"{time.time()-t_search:.1f}s")

# ── Step 4: Results summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
gs_df = pd.DataFrame(gs_results).sort_values('rmse').reset_index(drop=True)
print("\nTop 10 configurations:")
print(gs_df.head(10).to_string(index=False))
gs_df.to_csv('ard_elasticnet_grid_search_results.csv', index=False)

# ── Step 5: Plot results ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5), dpi=150)

# Plot ARD variants
ard_names = [k for k in ESTIMATORS.keys() if 'ard' in k]
for est_name in ard_names:
    for n_nearest in N_NEAREST_OPTIONS:
        sub = gs_df[
            (gs_df['estimator'] == est_name) &
            (gs_df['n_nearest'] == n_nearest)
        ].sort_values('max_iter')
        axes[0].plot(
            sub['max_iter'], sub['rmse'],
            marker='o',
            label=f'{est_name} (n={n_nearest})'
        )
axes[0].set_title('ARD Variants', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[0].set_xlabel('max_iter', fontsize=10)
axes[0].set_ylabel('RMSE (masked recovery)', fontsize=10)
axes[0].legend(fontsize=7, bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left')
axes[0].spines['top'].set_visible(False)
axes[0].spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Add reference line for KNN RMSE
axes[0].axhline(y=11.20, color='red', linestyle='--', lw=1.5,
                label='KNN baseline (11.20)')

# Plot ElasticNet variants
en_names = [k for k in ESTIMATORS.keys() if 'elasticnet' in k]
for est_name in en_names:
    for n_nearest in N_NEAREST_OPTIONS:
        sub = gs_df[
            (gs_df['estimator'] == est_name) &
            (gs_df['n_nearest'] == n_nearest)
        ].sort_values('max_iter')
        axes[1].plot(
            sub['max_iter'], sub['rmse'],
            marker='o',
            label=f'{est_name} (n={n_nearest})'
        )
axes[1].set_title('ElasticNet Variants', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
axes[1].set_xlabel('max_iter', fontsize=10)
axes[1].set_ylabel('RMSE (masked recovery)', fontsize=10)
axes[1].legend(fontsize=7, bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left')
axes[1].spines['top'].set_visible(False)
axes[1].spines['right'].set_visible(False)
axes[1].axhline(y=11.20, color='red', linestyle='--', lw=1.5,
                label='KNN baseline (11.20)')

fig.suptitle('MICE Focused Grid Search — ARD vs ElasticNet\n'
             'Red dashed line = KNN baseline RMSE (11.20)',
             fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('ard_elasticnet_grid_search.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

# ── Step 6: Final imputation with best params ─────────────────────────────────
best_row      = gs_df.iloc[0]
best_est_name = best_row['estimator']
best_n_nearest = int(best_row['n_nearest'])
best_max_iter  = int(best_row['max_iter'])

_log(f"\nStep 4/5  Final imputation — "
     f"estimator={best_est_name!r}, "
     f"n_nearest={best_n_nearest}, "
     f"max_iter={best_max_iter}, "
     f"RMSE={best_row['rmse']:.4f}")

t_final = time.time()
col_means_f = np.nanmean(X, axis=0)
col_stds_f  = np.nanstd(X,  axis=0)
col_stds_f[col_stds_f == 0] = 1
X_scaled_f = (X - col_means_f) / col_stds_f

itera_best = IterativeImputer(
    random_state=42,
    initial_strategy='mean',
    estimator=ESTIMATORS[best_est_name],
    n_nearest_features=best_n_nearest,
    max_iter=best_max_iter,
    tol=0.01,
    imputation_order='roman',
    skip_complete=True,
)
X_imp_f     = itera_best.fit_transform(X_scaled_f)
X_imp_inv_f = X_imp_f * col_stds_f + col_means_f
_log(f"          Imputation complete", t_final)

# ── Step 7: Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
_log("Step 5/5  Saving outputs")
df_imputed_mice = pd.DataFrame(X_imp_inv_f, columns=col_names)
df_imputed_mice['Source Name'] = ordered_df['Source Name'].values
df_imputed_mice['Group']       = ordered_df['Group'].values
df_imputed_mice.to_csv('full_df_mice_ard.csv', index=False)

joblib.dump(
    {
        'estimator':          best_est_name,
        'estimator_object':   ESTIMATORS[best_est_name],
        'n_nearest_features': best_n_nearest,
        'max_iter':           best_max_iter,
        'col_means':          col_means_f,
        'col_stds':           col_stds_f,
        'col_names':          col_names,
        'grid_search_results': gs_df.to_dict(),
    },
    'mice_ard_pipeline.joblib'
)
_log(f"          Saved: full_df_mice_ard.csv + mice_ard_pipeline.joblib")
_log(f"          Best config: {best_est_name}, "
     f"n_nearest={best_n_nearest}, max_iter={best_max_iter}, "
     f"RMSE={best_row['rmse']:.4f}")

plot_correlation_matrix(df_imputed_mice, "MICE  Correlation Matrix (Top 50x50)", save_path="full_df_mice_elasticnet_weak.png")
```

## Hybrid Imputation

```{python}
#| label: Hybrid Imputation
#| echo: false

import time

def _hlog(msg, t0=None):
    elapsed = f"  (+{time.time()-t0:.1f}s)" if t0 is not None else ""
    print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}]{elapsed}  {msg}")

# ┌─ PIPELINE JOBLLIBS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
# │ Each entry: name → (joblib path, full-data fill CSV path)                   │
# │ Joblib is used to reconstruct the imputer for honest masked RMSE evaluation. │
# │ Fill CSV provides the actual imputed values at missing positions.            │
PIPELINES = {
    'knn':          ('knn2_impute_full_df_pipeline.joblib',  'full_df_knn2.csv'),
    'mice_elastic': ('mice_ard_pipeline.joblib',             'full_df_mice_elastic_weak.csv'),
}
FALLBACK_METHOD = 'mice_elastic'   # for columns with no hold-out values
# └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

CATEGORY_FILES = {
    'rnaseq':    'rnaseq_columns.csv',
    'protein':   'protein_columns.csv',
    'microct':   'microct_columns.csv',
    'hne':       'hne_columns.csv',
    'tunel':     'tunel_columns.csv',
    'pna':       'pna_columns.csv',
    'zo1':       'zo1_columns.csv',
    'tonometry': 'tonometry_columns.csv',
}

if os.path.exists('full_df_hybrid.csv'):
    _hlog("Cache hit — loading full_df_hybrid.csv")
    hybrid_df = pd.read_csv('full_df_hybrid.csv')
    sel_df    = pd.read_csv('full_df_hybrid_selection.csv')
    _hlog(f"Loaded: {hybrid_df.shape[0]} rows × {hybrid_df.shape[1]} cols")
else:
    t_total = time.time()

    # ── 1. Load pipelines + full-data fill CSVs ───────────────────────────────
    _hlog("Step 1/5  Loading saved pipelines and fill CSVs")
    pipes, fill_arrs = {}, {}
    for name, (jpath, cpath) in PIPELINES.items():
        for p in (jpath, cpath):
            if not os.path.exists(p):
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing file for {name!r}: {p}")
        pipes[name] = joblib.load(jpath)
        _hlog(f"       {name!r}  ← {jpath}")

    col_names_h = pipes['knn']['col_names']
    for name, p in pipes.items():
        if p['col_names'] != col_names_h:
            raise ValueError(f"Column mismatch between pipelines at {name!r}")

    for name, (_, cpath) in PIPELINES.items():
        df_c = pd.read_csv(cpath)
        missing = [c for c in col_names_h if c not in df_c.columns]
        if missing:
            raise KeyError(f"Fill CSV for {name!r} missing columns: {missing[:5]}")
        fill_arrs[name] = df_c[col_names_h].values.astype(float)
        _hlog(f"       {name!r} fill CSV  ← {cpath}  {fill_arrs[name].shape}")

    if FALLBACK_METHOD not in pipes:
        raise ValueError(f"FALLBACK_METHOD={FALLBACK_METHOD!r} not in PIPELINES: {list(pipes)}")

    # ── 2. Original matrix + hold-out mask ────────────────────────────────────
    # col_names_h may include 'Group_ordinal' (a computed column, not in ordered_df).
    # Build it by selecting real columns first, then appending the ordinal encoding.
    _hlog("Step 2/5  Building feature matrix and hold-out mask (seed=42, 10%)")
    df_cols        = [c for c in col_names_h if c in ordered_df.columns]
    X_feat         = ordered_df[df_cols].values.astype(float)
    if 'Group_ordinal' in col_names_h:
        _ord_map   = {'F': 0, 'GC': 1, 'CC1': 2, 'CC2': 3, 'Viv': 4}
        _g_ord     = ordered_df['Group'].map(_ord_map).values.reshape(-1, 1)
        X_orig     = np.hstack([X_feat, _g_ord])   # Group_ordinal is always last
    else:
        X_orig     = X_feat
    n_rows_h, n_cols_h = X_orig.shape
    n_miss_h       = int(np.isnan(X_orig).sum())
    _hlog(f"       {n_rows_h} rows × {n_cols_h} cols  |  "
          f"{n_miss_h} NaN ({100*n_miss_h/(n_rows_h*n_cols_h):.1f}%)")

    rng_h       = np.random.default_rng(42)
    known_h     = ~np.isnan(X_orig)
    test_mask_h = known_h & (rng_h.random(X_orig.shape) < 0.10)
    holdout_h   = {j: np.where(test_mask_h[:, j])[0]
                   for j in range(n_cols_h) if test_mask_h[:, j].any()}
    _hlog(f"       {len(holdout_h)} cols have hold-out values  "
          f"({int(test_mask_h.sum())} total held-out values)")

    X_masked_h          = X_orig.copy()
    X_masked_h[test_mask_h] = np.nan
    col_means_m         = np.nanmean(X_masked_h, axis=0)
    col_stds_m          = np.nanstd(X_masked_h,  axis=0)
    col_stds_m[col_stds_m == 0] = 1
    X_scaled_m          = (X_masked_h - col_means_m) / col_stds_m

    # ── 3. Re-run imputers on masked data → honest per-column RMSE ───────────
    eval_arrs = {}
    for name, p in pipes.items():
        _hlog(f"Step 3/5  Re-running {name!r} on masked data …")
        t_run = time.time()
        if name == 'knn':
            imp = KNNImputer(**p['params'])
        else:
            imp = IterativeImputer(
                random_state=2,
                estimator=p['estimator_object'],
                n_nearest_features=p['n_nearest_features'],
                max_iter=p['max_iter'],
                tol=0.01, imputation_order='roman', skip_complete=True,
            )
        X_imp_z          = imp.fit_transform(X_scaled_m)
        eval_arrs[name]  = X_imp_z * col_stds_m + col_means_m
        _hlog(f"       done", t_run)

    # ── 4. Per-column selection ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    _hlog("Step 4/5  Per-column method selection")
    cols_with_missing = [j for j in range(n_cols_h) if np.isnan(X_orig[:, j]).any()]
    total_missing     = sum(int(np.isnan(X_orig[:, j]).sum()) for j in cols_with_missing)
    _hlog(f"       {len(cols_with_missing)} columns with missing values  |  "
          f"{total_missing} total NaN  ({100*total_missing/(n_rows_h*n_cols_h):.1f}% of matrix)")

    selection_rows = []
    X_hybrid       = X_orig.copy()

    for j in cols_with_missing:
        nan_rows = np.where(np.isnan(X_orig[:, j]))[0]
        if j not in holdout_h:
            chosen   = FALLBACK_METHOD
            rmse_map = {m: np.nan for m in pipes}
        else:
            rows      = holdout_h[j]
            true_vals = X_orig[rows, j]
            col_std   = col_stds_m[j]
            rmse_map  = {
                name: float(np.sqrt(np.mean(((arr[rows, j] - true_vals) / col_std) ** 2)))
                for name, arr in eval_arrs.items()
            }
            chosen = min(rmse_map, key=rmse_map.get)

        X_hybrid[nan_rows, j] = fill_arrs[chosen][nan_rows, j]
        selection_rows.append({'col': col_names_h[j], 'chosen': chosen,
                                **{f'rmse_{m}': rmse_map[m] for m in pipes}})

    sel_df = pd.DataFrame(selection_rows)
    _hlog("       Method selection distribution:")
    display(sel_df['chosen'].value_counts().rename('cols').to_frame())

    # ── 5. Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    _hlog("Step 5/5  Saving outputs")
    hybrid_df = pd.DataFrame(X_hybrid, columns=col_names_h)
    hybrid_df['Source Name'] = ordered_df['Source Name'].values
    hybrid_df['Group']       = ordered_df['Group'].values
    hybrid_df.to_csv('full_df_hybrid.csv', index=False)
    sel_df.to_csv('full_df_hybrid_selection.csv', index=False)
    joblib.dump({'pipelines': PIPELINES, 'fallback': FALLBACK_METHOD,
                 'col_names': col_names_h, 'selection': sel_df.to_dict('records')},
                'hybrid_imputer.joblib')
    _hlog(f"       Saved  |  total elapsed: {time.time()-t_total:.1f}s")

# ── Plots ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
m1, m2 = list(PIPELINES.keys())[:2]

# ① Per-column RMSE scatter
sub      = sel_df.dropna(subset=[f'rmse_{m1}', f'rmse_{m2}'])
r1, r2   = sub[f'rmse_{m1}'].values, sub[f'rmse_{m2}'].values
lim      = max(r1.max(), r2.max()) * 1.05
colors_h = sub['chosen'].map({m1: '#4C72B0', m2: '#DD8452'}).fillna('#aaaaaa')

fig_h, ax_h = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6), dpi=150)
ax_h.scatter(r1, r2, c=colors_h, alpha=0.4, s=8, linewidths=0)
ax_h.plot([0, lim], [0, lim], 'k--', lw=1, alpha=0.5)
ax_h.set_xlim(0, lim); ax_h.set_ylim(0, lim)
ax_h.set_xlabel(f'RMSE (z-score) — {m1}', fontsize=11)
ax_h.set_ylabel(f'RMSE (z-score) — {m2}', fontsize=11)
ax_h.set_title(f'Per-column RMSE: {m1} vs {m2}\n(blue={m1} wins, orange={m2} wins)', fontsize=11)
ax_h.spines['top'].set_visible(False); ax_h.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('hybrid_rmse_scatter.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

# ② RMSE delta histogram
delta = r1 - r2
fig_d, ax_d = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3), dpi=150)
ax_d.hist(delta, bins=60, color='#55A868', edgecolor='none', alpha=0.8)
ax_d.axvline(0, color='k', lw=1.2, ls='--')
ax_d.set_xlabel(f'RMSE({m1}) − RMSE({m2})  (positive → {m2} better)', fontsize=10)
ax_d.set_ylabel('Columns', fontsize=10)
ax_d.set_title('RMSE difference distribution per column (z-score space)', fontsize=11)
ax_d.spines['top'].set_visible(False); ax_d.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('hybrid_rmse_delta.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

# ③ Category breakdown
col_to_cat = {}
for cat, fpath in CATEGORY_FILES.items():
    if os.path.exists(fpath):
        for col in pd.read_csv(fpath, header=None).iloc[:, 0]:
            col_to_cat[str(col)] = cat

sel_df['category'] = sel_df['col'].map(col_to_cat).fillna('other')
cat_counts = (sel_df.groupby(['category', 'chosen'])
                     .size().unstack(fill_value=0)
                     .sort_values(m1, ascending=False))
cat_pct = cat_counts.div(cat_counts.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

fig_c, axes_c = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5), dpi=150)
cat_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes_c[0], color=['#4C72B0', '#DD8452'],
                edgecolor='none', width=0.7)
axes_c[0].set_title('Columns won per feature category (count)', fontsize=12)
axes_c[0].set_xlabel(''); axes_c[0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=30)
axes_c[0].spines['top'].set_visible(False); axes_c[0].spines['right'].set_visible(False)

cat_pct.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes_c[1], color=['#4C72B0', '#DD8452'],
             edgecolor='none', width=0.7)
axes_c[1].set_title('Columns won per feature category (%)', fontsize=12)
axes_c[1].set_ylabel('%'); axes_c[1].set_xlabel('')
axes_c[1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=30)
axes_c[1].spines['top'].set_visible(False); axes_c[1].spines['right'].set_visible(False)

plt.suptitle('Hybrid Imputation — Method Selection by Feature Category',
             fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', y=1.01)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('hybrid_category_breakdown.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
display(cat_counts)

plot_correlation_matrix(hybrid_df, "Hybrid Imputation Correlation Matrix (Top 50x50)",
                        save_path="full_df_hybrid.png")
```
